declarations.statement: Definition controlled {State : Type} (action : State -> State) (control : bool) (state : State) := if control then action state else state

declarations.name: signed_apply
declarations.statement: Definition signed_apply (action : signed_xor_action) (phase : bool) (label : nat) : bool * nat := (xorb phase (action_phase action label), Nat.lxor label (action_offset action))

declarations.name: signed_compose
declarations.statement: Definition signed_compose (first second : signed_xor_action) : signed_xor_action := SignedXor (Nat.lxor (action_offset first) (action_offset second)) (fun label => xorb (action_phase first label) (action_phase second (Nat.lxor label (action_offset first))))

declarations.name: signed_composition_exact

declarations.name: controlled_signed
declarations.statement: Definition controlled_signed (action : signed_xor_action) (control phase : bool) (label : nat) := if control then signed_apply action phase label else (phase, label)

declarations.name: controlled_signed_label
declarations.statement: Theorem controlled_signed_label : forall action control phase label, snd (controlled_signed action control phase label) = if control then Nat.lxor label (action_offset action) else label

declarations.name: controlled_signed_phase
declarations.statement: Theorem controlled_signed_phase : forall action control phase label, fst (controlled_signed action control phase label) = xorb phase (andb control (action_phase action label))

declarations.name: controlled_signed_disabled_identity
declarations.statement: Theorem controlled_signed_disabled_identity : forall action phase label, controlled_signed action false phase label = (phase, label)

declarations.name: controlled_signed_composition
declarations.statement: Theorem controlled_signed_composition : forall first second control phase label, let intermediate := controlled_signed first control phase label in controlled_signed second control (fst intermediate) (snd intermediate) = controlled_signed (signed_compose first second) control phase label

declarations.name: signed_word_label_projection

declarations.name: signed_xor_fixed_zero_label_identity
declarations.statement: Theorem signed_xor_fixed_zero_label_identity : forall action, snd (signed_apply action false 0) = 0 -> forall phase label, snd (signed_apply action phase label) = label

declarations.name: signed_word_fixed_zero_label_identity

declarations.name: nonconstant_diagonal

declarations.name: diagonal_phase_preserves_labels

declarations.name: diagonal_control_relative_phase

declarations.name: affine_on_five_bits

declarations.name: n21_moves_one

declarations.name: n21_nonaffine

[[witness.declarations]]
name = "binary_channel"
statement = "Definition binary_channel (false_positive true_positive input_mean : R) : R := false_positive * (1 - input_mean) + true_positive * input_mean"
assumptions = ["ClassicalDedekindReals.sig_forall_dec"]

[[witness.declarations]]
name = "binary_channel_contracts_separation"
statement = "Theorem binary_channel_contracts_separation : forall false_positive true_positive first_mean second_mean, 0 <= false_positive <= 1 -> 0 <= true_positive <= 1 -> Rabs (binary_channel false_positive true_positive first_mean - binary_channel false_positive true_positive second_mean) <= Rabs (first_mean - second_mean)"
assumptions = ["ClassicalDedekindReals.sig_forall_dec", "FunctionalExtensionality.functional_extensionality_dep"]

[[witness.declarations]]
name = "absolute_radius_bounds"
statement = "Lemma absolute_radius_bounds : forall value center radius, Rabs (value - center) <= radius -> center - radius <= value <= center + radius"
assumptions = ["ClassicalDedekindReals.sig_forall_dec", "FunctionalExtensionality.functional_extensionality_dep"]

[[witness.declarations]]
name = "difference_radius_bound"
statement = "Theorem difference_radius_bound : forall first second first_center second_center first_radius second_radius, Rabs (first - first_center) <= first_radius -> Rabs (second - second_center) <= second_radius -> Rabs ((first - second) - (first_center - second_center)) <= first_radius + second_radius"
assumptions = ["ClassicalDedekindReals.sig_forall_dec", "FunctionalExtensionality.functional_extensionality_dep"]

[[witness.declarations]]
name = "separation_radius_bound"
statement = "Theorem separation_radius_bound : forall first second first_center second_center first_radius second_radius, Rabs (first - first_center) <= first_radius -> Rabs (second - second_center) <= second_radius -> Rabs (first - second) <= Rabs (first_center - second_center) + first_radius + second_radius"
assumptions = ["ClassicalDedekindReals.sig_forall_dec", "FunctionalExtensionality.functional_extensionality_dep"]

[[witness.declarations]]
name = "separated_centers_exclude_common_binary_channel"
statement = "Theorem separated_centers_exclude_common_binary_channel : forall output_first output_second input_first input_second output_first_center output_second_center input_first_center input_second_center output_first_radius output_second_radius input_first_radius input_second_radius, Rabs (output_first - output_first_center) <= output_first_radius -> Rabs (output_second - output_second_center) <= output_second_radius -> Rabs (input_first - input_first_center) <= input_first_radius -> Rabs (input_second - input_second_center) <= input_second_radius -> Rabs (input_first_center - input_second_center) + output_first_radius + output_second_radius + input_first_radius + input_second_radius < Rabs (output_first_center - output_second_center) -> ~ exists false_positive true_positive, 0 <= false_positive <= 1 /\\ 0 <= true_positive <= 1 /\\ output_first = binary_channel false_positive true_positive input_first /\\ output_second = binary_channel false_positive true_positive input_second"
assumptions = ["ClassicalDedekindReals.sig_forall_dec", "FunctionalExtensionality.functional_extensionality_dep"]
